Mira (CSM): Quick QBR sync for AcmeCorp — EBR next Tue. I need a compact list: slide owners, current onboarding blockers, renewal risk signals, and any exec asks. Drop short bullets and owner. Trying to keep thread tidy.

Jonah (AE): I can take the 'Business Outcomes' slide. Flag: CSM reported SSO setup lagging (customer waiting on Okta mapping). Owner for SSO follow-up: Jonah.

Sam (Renewals): Renewal at 60% signal. Finance worried about usage drop last 2 weeks. I'll own the renewal risk slide + churn mitigation bullets.

Leo (Eng): Happy to take 'Performance & Stability' — will call out two incidents in Feb and the healing we did. Blocking item: customer requested a dedicated dedupe cache knob — engineering estimate needed.

Mira (CSM): Adding onboarding blocker notes: - SSO mapping (Jonah) - Data pipeline flaky retry (Leo to triage with infra) - Missing workspace policies (Emily to confirm exec ask).

Emily (Exec Sponsor): Quick note: Exec ask = committed SLA for specific p95 latency, and a one-pager on cost optimization options before the call. Can't be on call but will provide a 3-bullet readout for the deck.

Jonah (AE): Uploading draft slide deck here: https://redwood.slides/acmecorp-qbr (please add comments inline).

qbr-bot: Reminder — Slide deck due EOD Fri (automated).

Mira (CSM): Mini action list (paste into deck notes):
```
- Jonah: Business Outcomes slide + SSO follow-up (owner) — due Thu noon
- Sam: Renewal risk slide + mitigation bullets — due Fri EOD
- Leo: Performance slide + engineering ask (dedupe cache estimate) — due Thu EOD
- Emily: Exec 3-bullet readout on SLA & cost options — due Fri noon
- Mira: Collate Q&A and finalize run order — due Mon morning
```

Mira (CSM): Any quick objections to owners or deadlines? If not I'll lock and ping design for final polish. :thumbsup:

Sam (Renewals): All good from my side. Adding a line about usage incentives we ran last quarter.

Leo (Eng): No objections. I'll ping infra now for the estimate, will post as a short message here when I have it.

Jonah (AE): Fine. I'll also reach out to their IT contact about Okta mapping today.

Mira (CSM): Great — thanks team. I'll update the deck notes and send a condensed run-of-show. If anything changes drop it here so I don't miss it. :sparkles:
